angle: Data-backed real estate investment for profit and certainty.
body_text:
The biggest thing holding buyers back isn't budget. It's not knowing if what they're buying is actually good. This data fixes that.

Hey, it’s Shanice here.

I’ve seen it happen too often. 

Buyers go from viewing to viewing, relying on gut feel, opinions, or what “sounds good”…

Only to second-guess themselves after committing.

The biggest misconception?

That property decisions should be based on instinct or hype.

But in today’s market, that’s risky.

Here’s what actually works 👇

✅ Data beats opinions, every single time

✅ Past transaction trends reveal real buyer behaviour

✅ The right shortlist saves you months of uncertainty

Here are some insights you may not know:

INSIGHT #1: The market already tells you what works.

We’ve compiled a database of hundreds of condos that TOPed in the last 10 years, tracking every unit, every transaction. 

This isn’t theory. It’s real buyers putting real money into proven projects.

INSIGHT #2: Not all condos perform equally.

By analysing annualised gains, rental data, and median PSF.

We can clearly see which developments consistently outperform.

And which ones don’t. The difference isn’t small.

INSIGHT #3: Clarity changes everything

Instead of walking into viewings unsure, you’ll have a refined shortlist already stress-tested against 10 years of market behaviour. 

That’s confidence most buyers never get.

📊 Condo Performance Data Set (Last 10 Years)

✅ How to avoid the costliest mistakes

✅ Which 3 projects have strong profit potential this year

✅ A framework to make your next move with confidence

If you want to stop guessing and start making data-backed decisions

click “Learn More” and I’ll walk you through it.
